description: boss-flush's boss pushed four tolerances (4e-7) into the plate, fused: the plate and a boss 10 − 4e-7 tall above it, volume 12000 + 16π(10 − 4e-7) = 12502.654804468 and area 3800 + 8π(10 − 4e-7) = 4051.327402234 in closed form, which Open CASCADE's reading of Arris's STEP gives to 1e-11. Open CASCADE's own fuse measures 12502.654817872 and 4051.327412287, a boss 1.3e-7 in and one a whole 10 tall — the far side, as in frustum-stub-cut-then-fuse — so the fixture states volume 2e-9 and area 5e-9 against its 1.07e-9 and 2.5e-9 (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
